title: Verify notification for user account creation
gherkin:
Feature: Lifecycle Event Notifications
  Scenario: User account creation notification
    Given a new user account is created
    When the system processes the account creation event
    Then a notification should be sent to the user about their account creation
rationale: To ensure that users are notified when their account is successfully created, confirming the lifecycle event.
generationSummary: Test cases for verifying the coverage of lifecycle event notifications in the system.
